note: Section 4.6 defines Max-Terminate as the number of unanswered Terminate-Requests. TestConfiguredLCPMaxTerminate drives Close with budgets of 2 and 4, requires exactly that many transmissions and Closed on exhaustion, and contrasts a matching first Terminate-Ack that closes after one request. Both branches explicitly require each emitted frame to use ProtoLCP and LCPTerminateRequest, so an unrelated LCP packet cannot satisfy the request-count claim. Both server transports configure this shared automaton; the client has no local Terminate-Request sender. Its PADT cleanup capability is documented separately, not treated as a general exemption for PPP clients.
